classification.difficultyReason: 1G Q10: Linked familiar operations with signs, exact values or endpoint/domain checks. The non-monic coefficients give the nonsquare discriminant 216, matching the demonstrated formula workflow.

answer.short:
$x=\dfrac{2\pm3\sqrt6}{5}$.

Use the quadratic formula and simplify $\sqrt{216}=6\sqrt6$.
answer.worked:
Use the quadratic formula with $a=5$, $b=-4$ and $c=-10$.
$$\begin{align*}x&=\frac{-(-4)\pm\sqrt{(-4)^2-4(5)(-10)}}{2(5)}\\x&=\frac{4\pm\sqrt{216}}{10}\\x&=\frac{4\pm6\sqrt6}{10}\\x&=\frac{2\pm3\sqrt6}{5}\end{align*}$$
